title: Confirming accepted offers
subtitle: One at a time, or a whole batch

captions.text: On Offers, open the view menu.
Choose Awaiting Confirmation to see offers staff have accepted.
Each row shows when the staff member accepted.
Confirm one offer with the tick.
Check the details, then select Confirm shift.
To confirm everyone else at once, select Confirm All Accepted.
Switch the view to Confirmed to see the updated statuses.
